backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ICP backend, defining data types and shared functions for products, shopping carts, user profiles, branding/homepage config, orders, discount codes, and payment settings, with access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that maps the old actor state (with image blobs) to the new actor state, preserving the products map during upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (discount code hooks, Payment Settings dashboard tab, checkout promo code field, etc.) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with a root div and module script entry point that bootstraps the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the app in ThemeProvider and Toaster, and applies dynamic branding via a custom hook.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin form component for updating site branding including site name, logo, and favicon uploads with preview, progress tracking, and submission via the useUpdateBrandingConfig mutation.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: A bulk product upload component that allows uploading multiple product images at once, with per-product fields (name, description, price, etc.), optional auto-copy from the first item, and description template selection.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: A dialog component for creating or editing a description template, with name and content fields, supporting both create and update mutations.
A manager UI that lists all description templates with options to create, edit, and delete them, using the DescriptionTemplateEditor dialog for create/edit operations.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A site footer component displaying the shop name, legal links, contact email from shop details, and a 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: An admin settings form for customizing the homepage hero section, allowing updates to the hero motto, promotional text, and hero image with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main application layout component providing a sticky header with navigation links, cart icon with item count, login/logout button, mobile menu, and a footer wrapping all page content via an Outlet.
frontend/src/components/OcarinaPanel.tsx: Renders an interactive ocarina note-playing panel with scale-specific color themes, displaying clickable note buttons that trigger audio playback via the ocarinaSynth utility.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSettingsT: Admin tab for managing discount codes (create, edit, delete) and payment settings such as the pro app URL and bonus item configuration, using React Query mutations and a dialog-based form.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a compact product card with image, name, category, price, and an add-to-cart button that calls the addToCart mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing full product details including image, description, price, shipping policy, and buttons to add to basket or proceed to checkout.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for viewing, filtering, and inline-editing products with support for image upload, inventory count adjustments, and bulk updates.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Stub component for a profile setup modal that is currently disabled and renders nothing.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Settings form card for managing shop details including name, contact information, address, opening hours, and company tax details, persisted via the updateShopDetails mutation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: React component for configuring Stripe payments, allowing users to input a secret key and allowed countries, with support for viewing current configuration status and deleting the config.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Custom hook that dynamically updates the document title and favicon based on branding configuration fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for all backend interactions, including products, cart, user profiles, Stripe configuration, discount codes, and shop settings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that configures Tailwind and defines a warm artisan-themed color palette (terracotta, earthy tones) for both light and dark modes using CSS custom properties.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays cart or buy-now items, supports promo code validation with discount calculation, and initiates a Stripe checkout session.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays store statistics (product count, inventory value, views) and provides tabbed management interfaces for products, settings, branding, and payments. Access is restricted to admin users.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Public marketplace page with a hero section, product search, and filters for shape/category/sort order, rendering filtered products as cards with a detail view modal.
frontend/src/pages/OcarinaStudio.tsx: Ocarina Studio page that lists products as studio cards, each allowing users to play a demo audio scale or open an interactive OcarinaPanel to play the instrument in-browser.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Simple payment failure page displaying an error message with buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that clears the cart, shows order confirmation, and conditionally displays bonus items and a Pro Ocarina Learning App link based on payment settings.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page covering data collection, usage, payment processing, shipping, returns, and user rights.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal options, shows the total price, and navigates to checkout. Uses React Query hooks for cart state management and formats prices in AUD.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static Terms & Conditions page rendered as a styled card, covering topics like products, pricing, shipping, returns, digital inclusions, and intellectual property for the Original Creations Hub marketplace.
frontend/src/utils/ocarinaSynth.ts: Web Audio API utility that synthesizes ocarina-like tones using blended oscillators with ADSR envelope shaping, and defines note frequencies and diatonic scale mappings for bass-low, bass, alto, and soprano ranges.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support for sensitive tokens like admin credentials.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, Inter/Crimson Pro fonts, border radii, box shadows, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 53) describing the Artisan Hub marketplace architecture, known issues (image persistence, cart errors), existing features, and design decisions such as Stripe-only checkout and bulk upload behavior.
